messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-4821 -> full fanout to eng-oncall, eng-sre. Node gpu-host-47 in rack-9 reported Kubelet timeout and serial console drop. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-4821

pagerduty: Alert details: metric=kubelet_sync_failed, node=gpu-host-47, severity=high, reason=kubelet not ready > 120s. Autoresolve disabled.

alice_oncall: acked. I'm on it, grabbing serial. Any logged customer impact yet?

ben_sre: looking at metrics — node lost kubelet heartbeat at 2026-03-15T12:14:02Z. GPU health probes also showing XID hangs. Likely kernel OOPS on NVidia driver.

charlie_platform: seeing a heap of pod restarts on that node. Some model-serving deployments are on that host: redwood-models-prod-rt, embedder-prod-1. Might be small % of traffic routed there.

dana_support: flagged a customer who reported 503s about 2m ago (ticket #SUP-9217). They're in eu-west and were routed to rack-9 historically.

alice_oncall: serial attached: getting a kernel backtrace, repeating stacktrace with nvidia_uvm. Paste below:

```
[   12.345678] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00:00: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[   12.345690] kernel: [drm] *ERROR* GPU panic - GPU stuck
[   12.346000] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception in interrupt
Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x53/0x7b
  panic+0x1d6/0x43e
  nvidia_panic_handler+0x2c/0x60
```

alice_oncall: kernel OOPS -> likely full host panic, kubelet not ready follows. I'm going to cordon/evict pods after we confirm customer impact.

ben_sre: agree. Plan: cordon node, drain with --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data, and mark for RMA if serial logs show persistent hardware fault. Also escalate to infra-hardware.

charlie_platform: I'll trigger fallback routing for model-serving group to route traffic away from rack-9 for the next 30m. Quick command: `rwctl route update-models --block rack-9 --ttl 1800`

alice_oncall: performing cordon now: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-47` -> output: `node/gpu-host-47 cordoned`

alice_oncall: starting drain: `kubectl drain gpu-host-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

alice_oncall: drain progress: 12/16 pods evicted; 4 pods pending because of PV mount conflicts and a statefulset that needs graceful termination.

ben_sre: trying a safe taint to prevent new scheduling: `kubectl taint nodes gpu-host-47 node.kubernetes.io/unavailable:NoSchedule`

charlie_platform: fallback routing applied. Health checks show model-serving error rate dropping from 8% -> 0.6% in eu-west. Will keep monitoring.

dana_support: alerted the impacted customer with a short note: "We observed a node failure causing intermittent 503s; traffic routed away and we are mitigating. We'll update in 30m."

alice_oncall: pv blocker: `embed-ldb-prod` is using local emptyDir and refused eviction. I'll force-delete the pod after we snapshot. Asking infra to snapshot logs and data if possible.

ben_sre: copying serial logs to ops bucket now and opening hardware ticket: RMA request created -> RMA-2087.

incident-bot: escalation: if ack not re-assigned in 10m, page infra-hardware. (auto rule: kernel-panic -> escalate)

charlie_platform: rolling fallback for the rest of rack-9 completed. Traffic fully out of rack-9 in ~4 minutes.

alice_oncall: forced delete on blocked pod completed, replaced on healthy node. Drain now 16/16 -> complete. Node drained and marked unschedulable.

ben_sre: kubelet logs after drain show repeated kernel oops and machine is not coming up. Marking node for cordon+rma: `machine-state set gpu-host-47 rma_pending`

alice_oncall: summary for postmortem: root cause: GPU driver/kernel panic causing node kernel OOPS -> kubelet not ready -> automated PagerDuty fanout. Mitigation: cordon+drain, forced pod relocation, routing fallback applied, RMA requested.

dana_support: customer update posted to SUP-9217 and incident channel. No large-scale customer impact; a handful of requests in eu-west saw transient failures for ~2-6 minutes.

ben_sre: follow-ups: add a rule to incident-bot to include model group mapping in initial alert (so platform can auto-failover model-serving groups), and investigate NVidia driver version on rack-9.

charlie_platform: noted. I'll also add a temporary runbook step to run `rwctl route update-models` as part of the oncall triage page.

alice_oncall: will keep node offline and coordinate with infra-hardware tomorrow for RMA. Closing this thread after we collect logs and open postmortem. :thumbsup:
